unsigned-telemetry: abstained / negative_transfer / integrity_failures are report fields and do not feed the supported verdict

single-container-runtime: the enforced boundary was demonstrated with Docker only; podman is supported by name and unexercised
local-image-pin: image integrity is a re-checked local image id, not a registry attestation chain

manifest-not-publisher-signed: RELEASE_SHA256.json is locally generated and detects drift, not authorship; the v3.5.1 provenance statement is unsigned, a downgrade from the signed DSSE envelope shipped in v3.3.2
no-capability-evaluation: no model-weight or task-success benchmark was run; no reasoning-capability improvement is claimed
audit-baseline-unexplained: the prior audit's 45 baseline failures did not reproduce in the pinned environment and remain unattributed
